mn109:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde.
mn109:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā tadahu 'posathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṃghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
mn109:3.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu uṭṭhāy' āsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn109:3.2: Puccheyyāhaṃ, bhante, Bhagavantaṃ kiñcid eva desaṃ, sace me Bhagavā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
mn109:3.3: Tena hi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sake āsane nisīditvā puccha yad ākaṅkhasīti.
mn109:3.4: Atha kho so bhikkhu sake āsane nisīditvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn109:4.1: Ime nu kho, bhante, pañc' upādānakkhandhā, seyyathīdam --
mn109:4.2: rūpūpādānakkhandho vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhandho saṃkhārūpādānakkhandho viññāṇūpādānakkhandho ti?
mn109:4.3: Ime kho, bhikkhu, pañc' upādānakkhandhā, seyyathīdaṃ --
mn109:4.4: rūpūpādānakkhandho vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhandho saṃkhārūpādānakkhandho viññāṇūpādānakkhandho ti.
mn109:4.5: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
mn109:5.1: Ime pana, bhante, pañc' upādānakkhandhā kiṃmūlakā ti?
mn109:5.2: Ime kho, bhikkhu, pañc' upādānakkhandhā chandamūlakā ti.
mn109:6.1: Taṃ yeva nu kho, bhante, upādānaṃ te pañc' upādānakkhandhā? Udāhu aññatara pañc' upādānakkhandhehi upādānan ti?
mn109:6.2: Na kho, bhikkhu, taṃ yeva upādānaṃ te pañc' upādānakkhandhā, na pi aññatra pañc' upādānakkhandhehi upādānaṃ.
mn109:6.3: Yo kho, bhikkhu, pañc' upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānan ti.
mn109:7.1: Siyā pana, bhante, pañc' upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavemattatā ti?
mn109:7.4: evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsañño siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsaṃkhāro siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyām anāgatamaddhānan ti.
mn109:7.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, pañc' upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavemattatā ti.
mn109:8.1: Kittāvatā pana, bhante, khandhānaṃ khandhādhivacanaṃ hotīti?
mn109:8.2: Yaṃ kiñci, bhikkhu, rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, ayaṃ rūpakkhandho.
mn109:8.3: Yā kāci vedanā atītānāgatapaccuppannā ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikā vā sukhumā vā hīnā vā paṇītā vā yā dūre santike vā, ayaṃ vedanākkhandho.
mn109:8.4: Yā kāci saññā atītānāgatapaccuppannā . . . santike vā, ayaṃ saññākkhandho.
mn109:8.5: Ye keci saṃkhārā . . . santike vā, ayaṃ saṃkhārakkhandho.
mn109:8.6: Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ . . . santike vā, ayaṃ viññāṇakkhando.
mn109:8.7: Ettāvatā kho, bhikkhu, khandhānaṃ khandhādhivacanaṃ hotīti.
mn109:9.1: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya?
mn109:9.2: Ko hetu ko paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya?
mn109:9.3: Ko hetu ko paccayo saññākkhandhassa paññāpanāya?
mn109:9.4: Ko hetu ko paccayo saṃkhārakkhandhassa paññāpanāya?
mn109:9.5: Ko hetu ko paccayo viññāṇakkhandhassa paññāpanāyāti?
mn109:9.6: Cattāro kho, bhikkhu, mahābhūtā hetu, cattāro mahābhūtā paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
mn109:9.7: Phasso hetu phasso paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
mn109:9.8: Phasso hetu phasso paccayo saññākkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
mn109:9.9: Phasso hetu phasso paccayo saṃkhārakkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
mn109:9.10: Nāmarūpaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu nāmarūpaṃ paccayo viññāṇakkhandhassa paññāpanāyāti.
mn109:10.2: Idha, bhikkhu, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto, --
mn109:10.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
mn109:10.4: vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā vedanaṃ, vedanāya vā attānaṃ;
mn109:10.5: saññaṃ attato samanupassati, saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saññaṃ, saññāya vā attānaṃ:
mn109:10.6: saṃkhāre attato samanupassati, saṃkhāravantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saṃkhāre, saṃkhāresu vā attānaṃ;
mn109:10.7: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn109:11.1: Kathaṃ pana, bhante, sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti?
mn109:11.2: Idha, bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto, --
mn109:11.3: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, nāttani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
mn109:11.4: na vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, na vedanāvantaṃ . . . na vedanāya vā attānaṃ;
mn109:11.5: na saññaṃ . . . na saññāya vā attānaṃ;
mn109:11.6: na saṃkhāre . . . na saṃkhāresu vā attānaṃ; na
mn109:11.8: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti.
mn109:12.1: Ko nu kho, bhante, rūpe assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
mn109:12.2: Ko vedanāya assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
mn109:12.3: Ko saññāya assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
mn109:12.4: Ko saṃkhāresu assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
mn109:12.5: Ko viññāṇe assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇan ti?
mn109:12.6: Yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ rūpe assādo.
mn109:12.7: Yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpe ādīnavo.
mn109:12.8: Yo rūpe chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpe nissaraṇaṃ.
mn109:12.9: Yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, vedanaṃ paṭicca -- pe
mn109:12.12: viññāṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ viññāṇe assādo.
mn109:12.13: Yaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ viññāṇe ādīnavo.
mn109:12.14: Yo viññāṇe chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ, idaṃ viññāṇe nissaraṇan ti.
mn109:13.1: Kathaṃ pana, bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato imasmiñ ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṃkāramamaṃkāramānānusayā na hontīti?
mn109:13.2: Yaṃ kiñci, bhikkhu, rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ: N' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham asmi, na me so attā ti, -- evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
mn109:13.6: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ . . . sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ; N' etaṃ . . . attā ti, -- evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
mn109:13.7: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato imasmiñ ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṃkāramamaṃkāramānānusayā na hontīti.
mn109:14.1: Atha kho aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
mn109:14.2: Iti kira, bho, rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṃkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā,
mn109:14.4: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā ceto parivitakkaṃ aññāya bhikkhū āmantesi:--
mn109:14.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ, bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco moghapuriso avidvā avijjāgato taṇhādhipateyyena cetasā Satthu sāsanaṃ atidhāvitabbaṃ maññeyya:
mn109:14.6: Iti kira, bho, rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā anattā saññā anattā saṃkhārā anattā viññāṇaṃ anattā
mn109:14.8: Paṭicca vinītā kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, tatra tatra tesu tesu dhammesu.
mn109:15.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti?
mn109:15.4: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti?
mn109:15.6: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallan nu taṃ samanupassitaṃ:
mn109:15.7: Etaṃ mama, eso 'ham asmi, eso me attā ti?
mn109:16.7: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti?
mn109:16.9: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallan nu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
mn109:16.10: Etaṃ mama, eso 'ham asmi, eso me attā ti?
mn109:16.12: Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā . . . sabbaṃ rūpaṃ: N' etaṃ . . . attā ti, -- evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn109:17.4: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ . . . sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ: N' etaṃ . . . attā ti, -- evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn109:17.5: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ nibbindati, vedanāya nibbindati, saññāya nibbindati, saṃkhāresu nibbindati, viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati;
mn109:18.1: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti:
mn109:18.2: Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
mn109:18.4: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. Imasmiṃ
mn109:18.5: kho pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti. 110.
